name: phasor
summary: Q32 phase accumulator. `inc` (note-derived) is the pitch, `pitch` (control, Q15) scales it, full-scale = ±1 octave, and `detune` (cents −50..50) adds an exact per-operator offset via `fm1_detune_pitch`. `fm` (audio, Q15) is scaled `<<16` (full-scale = ±π, the FM index), `mod` (control) is a small additive offset. Also outputs `mip`, the band-limited wave-table level `fm1_wave_mip(step)`, so a downstream `osc` can select the table whose top harmonic sits below Nyquist.
